source: TrustLensAI_ComputerVision_Logs_Layers_Formulas.xlsx — sheet 'Computer Vision RMTE (Master)' plus 'Logs ↔ Formula Inputs' and 'Logs ↔ Architecture Layers'
notes: Each Computer Vision pipeline stage emits telemetry; TrustLensAI platform layers ingest and evaluate it. TrustLensAI produces evidence; it does not certify compliance.

layers.key_fields: frames/images, camera/sensor model, resolution, timestamps, geo
layers.ingested_by: L0 · Foundation & Integration → L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry

layers.key_fields: resize/normalize, augmentation, denoise, condition tags
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry

layers.key_fields: learned features/embeddings (refs), backbone version
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry
layers.notes: Vector refs only; raw media in-perimeter

layers.key_fields: predictions (boxes/masks/labels), scores, per-condition/subgroup outputs
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance
layers.notes: Core log for DP, DE families

layers.key_fields: NMS output, thresholds, final detections, FP/FN outcomes
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: confidence bins, ECE inputs, uncertainty estimates
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: GradCAM/attention/saliency maps, deletion/insertion tests, concepts
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: OOD detection, digital/physical adversarial outcomes, certified radius
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: spoof/liveness verdicts (APCER/BPCER), presentation-attack detection
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: biometric encryption, consent chain, PIA, retention, redaction
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: safety-critical miss/false-alarm, ODD coverage, ASIL/SIL validation
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: latency (p50/95/99), fps throughput, post-compression accuracy, OTA updates
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry

layers.key_fields: drift, model registry, annotation IAA, incidents, post-market surveillance
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L2 · Observability → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: registered CV models, camera/sensor connectors, tenancy, model registry & provenance
layers.ingested_by: Anchors identity, model registry & tenancy for all logs

layers.key_fields: normalized CV spans/events, image redaction, event-bus refs
layers.ingested_by: Consumes all CV product logs; normalizes & redacts

layers.key_fields: reconstructed inference traces, dependency views, time-series (drift)
layers.ingested_by: Consumes canonical events (D1-gated / target)

layers.key_fields: evaluator outputs, task metrics, calibration, robustness, saliency scores
layers.ingested_by: Consumes inference/postprocess/robustness logs + gold sets

layers.key_fields: metric defs, thresholds, mappings, gold annotations & benchmarks, versions
layers.ingested_by: Supplies formulas/thresholds & reference data to L3
layers.notes: Governs the CV RMTE metric corpus

layers.key_fields: safety (ISO 26262), privacy/consent, fairness decisions, risk register, gates
layers.ingested_by: Consumes evaluation evidence; runs release gates

layers.key_fields: Evidence Pack manifest, RFC 6962 inclusion proofs / hashes, Trust Score (Q6)
layers.ingested_by: Assembles tamper-evident evidence + verdict

layers.key_fields: persona surfaces, scorecards, reports, notifications
layers.ingested_by: Consumes evidence & verdicts for reporting
